newsitem.title: MEXICO: Contal says Coca-Cola ups stake in firm.
newsitem.headline: Contal says Coca-Cola ups stake in firm.

text.p: The Coca-Cola Co is raising its stake in Mexican bottler Grupo Continental SA (Contal) to 17.33 percent from 10.67 percent, Contal officials said on Wednesday.

"Coca-Cola is buying 10 million Contal shares, which raises its participation to 17.33 percent from the 10.67 percent it held previously," Contal's finance director Miguel Angel Rabago Vite told Reuters.
He said Contal received $40 million from Coca-Cola for the transaction.
"The value per share was about 11.3 pesos in September and we sold the shares for 31.60 pesos, about three times book value," he said.
Contal has distribution rights for Coca-Cola in the central and northern states of Coahuila, Durango, Zacatecas, Aguascalientes, San Luis Potosi and Jalisco.
